            self.Debug("Entry skipped: SPY has no valid current price.")

            self.SubmitExit("profit target")

        exchange_hours = self.Securities[self.spy].Exchange.Hours
        previous_trading_day = exchange_hours.GetPreviousTradingDay(expiry)

        if self.Time.date() == previous_trading_day.date():
            self.SubmitExit("15:45 pre-expiration time stop")

            self.Transactions.CancelOrder(order.Id)

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract, -quantity)

        if self.pending_exit_symbol is not None:
            self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId

        self.Debug(f"Exit submitted ({reason}): {self.held_contract}.")

            self.Debug("Unexpected SPY exercise/assignment position detected; liquidating SPY.")
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.block_entry_date = today

        if self.held_contract is not None:
            if self.held_expiry.date() <= today:
                self.Debug("Option expiration processing detected an open contract; liquidating.")
                self.block_entry_date = today
                self.SubmitExit("expiration safeguard")
                return

            self.entry_order_id is None and

            self.block_entry_date != today and
            not self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested

            contract.Expiry.date()
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Expiry.date() >= min_expiry_date
        })

            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no expiration at least seven calendar days away.")
            return

        selected_expiry = expiry_dates[0]
        spy_bar = data.Bars.get(self.spy)
        spy_price = spy_bar.Close if spy_bar is not None else self.Securities[self.spy].Price
        minimum_strike = spy_price * 1.01

            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() == selected_expiry
            and contract.Strike >= minimum_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: no qualifying call strike for selected expiration.")
            return

        candidates.sort(key=lambda contract: (contract.Strike, str(contract.Symbol)))

        self.entry_contract = selected.Symbol
        self.entry_expiry = selected.Expiry
        self.entry_order_id = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1).OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Entering 1 SPY call: {selected.Symbol}")

            return

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Quantity
        if quantity == 0:
            return

        self.exit_order_id = self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract, -quantity).OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Submitting option exit ({reason}): {self.held_contract}")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.held_contract = self.entry_contract
                self.held_expiry = self.entry_expiry
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.entry_contract = None
                self.entry_expiry = None
                self.Debug(f"Entry filled at {self.entry_price:.2f}: {self.held_contract}")
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.entry_contract = None
                self.entry_expiry = None

        if orderEvent.OrderId == self.exit_order_id:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(f"Option exit filled: {self.held_contract}")
                self.exit_order_id = None
                self.held_contract = None
                self.held_expiry = None
                self.entry_price = None
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
                self.exit_order_id = None
